# MusicVerse

> AI-powered music creation platform: generate, edit, mix, and publish tracks with artificial intelligence. Available as a web app and Telegram Mini App.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of MusicVerse — AI music generation, editor, and community.
- [Community](/community): Discover public AI-generated tracks from other authors.
- [Artists](/artists): Browse AI artists and human creators on the platform.
- [Playlists](/playlists): Curated and user-made playlists.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles, guides and product updates.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Plans, credits, and subscription tiers.
- [Music Lab](/music-lab): Creative AI tools for sound design and experiments.
- [Lyrics Studio](/lyrics-studio): AI lyrics writing, analysis, and editing.
- [Guitar Studio](/guitar-studio): Guitar recording, chord and tab analysis.
- [Audio Hub](/audio-hub): Upload, record, and manage reference audio.
- [Templates](/templates): Starting points for new tracks and projects.
- [Music Graph](/music-graph): Explore tags and connections between tracks.

## Optional

- [Auth](/auth): Sign in / sign up.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of service.
- [Privacy](/privacy): Privacy policy.
